subject: website
name: My UBNet
summary: My UBNet, the profile page of the UBNet network: readable unminified scripts (script.js, ubnet.js, chats.js) and vendored ethers, served as written (no licence file). It runs no third-party code. It reads Ethereum from publicnode and profile data from ipfs.io when it opens, and relies on the UBNet server for feeds, so it is at most Level 3; it also loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
connections.note: Ethereum RPC read without a light client, called when the page opens.

connections.name: ipfs.io gateway
connections.note: Profile metadata fetched by CID when the page opens, trusted from the gateway.

connections.name: UBNet server
connections.note: Profile, feed and follower data are read from the UBNet indexer.

connections.name: Profile extras (Blockscout, EFP, Google favicons)
connections.note: Requested when a profile has NFTs, followers or links to show.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Stylesheet and font files fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
